newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi meeting with Italy unions/bosses not certain.
newsitem.headline: Prodi meeting with Italy unions/bosses not certain.

text.p: A planned meeting between Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi, unions and management will not necessarily take place on Friday, the prime minister's office said on Tuesday.
Earlier Prodi's office said a meeting to discuss the long-running metalworkers' dispute had been fixed for Friday.
The leaders of Italy's big three trades union federations on Monday asked for Prodi to intervene in the pay dispute that has been dragging on since June.
A spokesman for Prodi said the exact timing of the meeting still had to be decided.
